originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Nearest prior Braun-Davis-Solus arXiv:1608.01614 proves IDP=>unimodal for the two-part Payne generalization q=(r^m,s^x) (Theorem 4.1) and reserves the broader simplex class for new results plus explicit open problems (Section 5 Q5.1-5.4). Candidate's weight systems q=(1,1,1,2,2,2,t): t=1 is the two-part control (1^4,2^3) while t=3,9 are genuinely three-part, outside that theorem and inside the stated open regime; no source records Ehrhart polynomials, h* verdicts, or 2P decomposition witnesses for this line. Braun-Davis arXiv:1403.5378 gives free-sum/weak-Lefschetz structure on other families with no 2P census for this family. Konoike arXiv:2409.16648 proves magic positivity for Stasheff/symmetric-edge duals, different families and method. KS/polymake/GRDB hold low-dimensional types and bare volumes, no 6D parametric Ehrhart or decomposition tables. Values are not mechanically implied: degree-6 Ehrhart is not Pick-implied and length-7 palindromic h* can genuinely dip, so unimodality required computation.

value.rationale: Headline judged alone: closed exact census for three named 6D reflexive simplices in the threshold dimension where Gorenstein non-unimodality first appears, on a pre-committed Payne-generalizing line tied to the live Hibi-Oda/Brenti conjecture and the Braun-Davis-Solus open regime. Delivers per member exact Ehrhart polynomial, h* with unimodality verdict, and closed non-IDP certificate (full 37+37+46-row 2P tables plus one explicit indecomposable point each), i.e. three certified unimodal-but-not-IDP witnesses separating the converse in dimension 6. Object and invariant were motivated before counting, values were unknown and not forced, and a future worker on Hibi-Oda test suites, Ehrhart/IDP benchmarks, or toric references could reasonably retrieve the precise polynomials/vectors/witnesses. Vacuous segment-wide IDP=>unimodal direction is disclosed and does not erase the independently reusable exact data. This is the eligible narrow-exact-invariant form, not a textbook restatement, bare substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
